name: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians
definition: A ray-marching algorithm implemented on 3D Gaussians to study the impact of approximations like spatial overlap and sorting in 3DGS.
summary: Ray-marching on 3D Gaussians is a volumetric rendering technique that integrates a continuous probabilistic density field along camera rays to accurately resolve spatial overlap, distinguishing itself from rasterization approximations and neural SDF methods.
